title: Community Navigator snapshot data envelope
description: Data envelope embedded in the single-file offline snapshot build (R8, P2.3). The snapshot bakes exactly one viewer's permission-filtered export plus the resolved theme, and MUST state that viewer scope explicitly (D-044.5; integration plan 2026-07-06 section 6.4). Only the anonymous and group-member scopes are admissible for a baked artifact - never a facilitator, trusted, or private-bearing view - so a room-shown file cannot embed attributes above the audience's circle. Full custody chains and seed taxonomy data stay out of the critical bundle (section 6.4 budget discipline); the export projection already omits provenance envelopes and tiers by construction. Version semantics: instances carry schema_version; readers accept the same major - and, while the major is 0, the same minor (cn_model::accepts_schema) - and MUST reject unknown majors loudly with a typed error (I7, I3). A breaking change bumps the major and mints a new $id. Cross-file refs: the export payload resolves against schemas/op-log.schema.json (and transitively schemas/story-path.schema.json), which must be registered alongside this schema.

schema_version.description: schema_version accepted by 0.1-line readers: major 0, minor 1 (cn_model::accepts_schema).

viewer_scope.description: Explicit statement of whose view is baked into this artifact (D-044.5). This enum is deliberately closed: no trusted, self, facilitator, or private-bearing scope is representable.

viewer_context.description: The exact cn_perm::ViewerContext the embedded export was computed for.

export.description: Output of cn-api export_snapshot for the declared viewer: boundary_version, schema_version, serialized group template, and the permission-filtered projection.

theme.description: Resolved theme tokens for rendering, matching the theme member of schemas/theme-tokens.schema.json (tokens only; the adjustment report stays out of the bundle).
